finalText:
Found it. `src/core/settings.js` computed `maxRetries` from a variable called `retries` that was never defined — a leftover from a rename. That threw at link time and crashed the whole build; the 3 warnings earlier were just noise, not the cause.

Fixed it to read `env.retries`, falling back to `3`. Build now finishes clean: exit `0`, 3 warnings, 0 errors.
